expectedComments: Explain the AS-facing contract, selected inputs, exact observations, and the important ownership/boundary rule for: Constructs NAME_None. Copy-constructs a name. Interns a string as an FName. @param Other Text containing the plain name and optional numeric suffix. Exposes the canonical empty name constant. Returns an engine-interned static name by compiler-assigned identifier. @param Id Static-name table index emitted by the script compiler.
expectedObservations: Consume every non-void result and compare its exact semantic value. Use the returned reference in a follow-up mutation or identity check to prove aliasing.
inputs: Nominal values for every listed parameter, one default or empty state, and one behavior-specific boundary derived from the registration notes.
testScope: FName Name(); | FName Name(const FName& Other); | FName Name(const FString& Other); | const FName NAME_None; | const FName& Name = __STATIC_NAME(int Id);
